_why: The statement `archon enroll` shows before it asks, and the refusal it prints for a store entry whose policy does not list archon-enroll/1, are what all three CLI lanes must print BYTE-IDENTICALLY (docs/enroll.md §4). Each lane's unit suite reads THIS file: `cases` through its statement renderer and prompt, `policy_cases` through its policy refusal. The text is written from the specification, never copied from a lane. Contexts in `policy_cases` are stored sorted, as the store keeps them.

cases.name: no restrictions
cases.statement:
https://bitshelf.dev/api asks you to add a key to an account:
  account:      julia (bitspark)
  account id:   u_8f3c2a
  key:          ed25519:7a91b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f
  restrictions: none
the service may give this key the account's authority.
the request's deadline is about 2026-10-05T10:45:00Z, the service's word; it is not the key's expiry.
signing with the store key personal
cases.prompt: add this key to the account "julia (bitspark)"? [y/N]

policy_cases.name: a thesmos delegator key: the command keeps what it has
policy_cases.refusal:
enroll: key personal may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow "thesmos/fact/v2".
  to let it enroll, keeping what it has (key policy replaces the list):
    archon key policy personal --allow thesmos/fact/v2 --allow archon-enroll/1

policy_cases.name: an entry that allows nothing
policy_cases.refusal:
enroll: key locked may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow nothing.
  to let it enroll, keeping what it has (key policy replaces the list):
    archon key policy locked --allow archon-enroll/1

policy_cases.name: two contexts, kept in the store's order
policy_cases.refusal:
enroll: key work may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow "archon-login/1", "thesmos/fact/v2".
  to let it enroll, keeping what it has (key policy replaces the list):
    archon key policy work --allow archon-login/1 --allow thesmos/fact/v2 --allow archon-enroll/1

policy_cases.name: a context with a space needs quoting: no command, the list JSON-quoted
policy_cases.refusal:
enroll: key odd may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow "my context".
  key policy replaces the list: run archon key policy odd with --allow for each of "my context", and for archon-enroll/1

policy_cases.name: a leading @ is not bare for PowerShell
policy_cases.refusal:
enroll: key at may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow "@team/x".
  key policy replaces the list: run archon key policy at with --allow for each of "@team/x", and for archon-enroll/1

enroll: key full may not sign in archon-enroll/1: its policy is allow "ctx/00", "ctx/01", "ctx/02", "ctx/03", "ctx/04", "ctx/05", "ctx/06", "ctx/07", "ctx/08", "ctx/09", "ctx/10", "ctx/11", "ctx/12", "ctx/13", "ctx/14", "ctx/15".
  it already lists 16 contexts, the most a policy holds: drop one with archon key policy, or keep a separate key for enrollment
